messages:
priya: Quick question — for /v2/search should we return "results": null when there are no matches, or omit the key / return []? Our JS SDK treats null as an explicit absent result and throws in some places.

ben: I think for arrays we should return [] (empty array). Null is annoying for clients. For optional objects maybe omit the key entirely.

mike: Agreed on arrays. Edge case: streaming endpoints vs structured output where we have "metadata" object that might be optional. If metadata is empty, do we send {} or omit?

priya: For metadata I'd prefer omit when it's semantically absent. If metadata exists but has no fields, send {} — that indicates it was intentionally provided.

ben: TL;DR: arrays -> [], optional objects -> omit unless explicitly provided -> {} if intentionally empty.

eva: +1. Can we capture this in the JSON Schema and the SDK adapters so we avoid regressions?

schema-lint-bot: suggestion: add rule `no-null-for-array` and `prefer-absent-for-optional-object` to schema-lint. Also enforce `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` for these endpoints.

priya: I'll open a tiny PR to update the /v2/search schema and add the lint rule. Ping @ben for SDK follow-up. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

ben: I'll add adapter changes to make the JS SDK coerce null->[] for arrays during parsing (with a warning) and have a strict mode. Should we make the lint rule an error or warning for now?

mike: Make it a warning for one release, then error after the canary. Give teams time.

priya: Plan: 1) PR updates schema + lint rule (w/ warning) 2) Ben updates JS SDK adapter to coerce null->[] and log once 3) Run canary for two weeks 4) Flip lint to error and remove coercion.

eva: Add a test that simulates old model returning null to ensure the SDK warning path triggers.

priya: Will do. Assigning tasks: priya -> schema + lint PR, ben -> SDK adapter + tests, mike -> coordinate canary on dedicated clusters, eva -> add integration test to E2E harness.

ben: ETA: I can get a draft adapter change tomorrow.

priya: ETA PR by EOD today for schema + lint rule.

mike: I'll schedule canary window next Tue/Wed.

priya: cool. One more note: docs team — we should add a short blurb in API docs about 'empty array vs omitted object vs null' guidance. @docs (cc)

ben: :thumbsup:

schema-lint-bot: Rule created as `prefer-empty-array-over-null` (level: warning). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/infra/lints/15

priya: Thanks all. I'll close this thread once the PR lands and canary window is set.
